# Test fixtures

## speech-sample.mp4

A 7.5-second, 640×360 H.264/AAC clip. The video is FFmpeg's `testsrc2` pattern. The audio
is speech synthesised with `espeak-ng` (voice `en-us`, 150 wpm) from this original text:

> Welcome to ClipForge. This short test clip checks that every spoken word gets a timestamp.

The ClipForge authors created this file and dedicate it to the public domain under
[CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
